description: Test suite for GitHub Actions related functions in the github package, including listing workflows, running workflows, cancelling runs, listing artifacts, downloading artifacts, deleting logs, and retrieving usage and logs for workflow runs and jobs.

methods.name: Test_ListWorkflows
methods.description: Tests listing workflows, verifying schema properties and handling of successful and missing parameters.

methods.name: Test_RunWorkflow
methods.description: Tests initiating a workflow run, verifying success and missing parameter handling.

methods.name: Test_RunWorkflow_WithFilename
methods.description: Tests workflow run initiation using filename or ID, including error handling.

methods.name: Test_CancelWorkflowRun
methods.description: Tests cancelling a workflow run, including success and conflict error handling.

methods.name: Test_ListWorkflowRunArtifacts
methods.description: Tests listing artifacts for a workflow run, verifying schema and response.

methods.name: Test_DownloadWorkflowRunArtifact
methods.description: Tests downloading an artifact, verifying redirect URL and missing parameter handling.

methods.name: Test_DeleteWorkflowRunLogs
methods.description: Tests deleting logs of a workflow run, verifying success and missing parameter handling.

methods.name: Test_GetWorkflowRunUsage
methods.description: Tests retrieving usage data for a workflow run, verifying response structure.

methods.name: Test_GetJobLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieving logs for a job, including URL redirect and content retrieval, with various scenarios.

methods.name: Test_GetJobLogs_WithContentReturn
methods.description: Tests returning log content directly instead of URL.

methods.name: Test_GetJobLogs_WithContentReturnAndTailLines
methods.description: Tests returning last lines of logs with tail_lines parameter.

methods.name: Test_GetJobLogs_WithContentReturnAndLargeTailLines
methods.description: Tests returning entire logs with large tail_lines parameter.

methods.name: Test_MemoryUsage_SlidingWindow_vs_NoWindow
methods.description: Memory profiling test comparing ring buffer approach vs reading all content into memory.

methods.name: Test_ListWorkflowRuns
methods.description: Tests listing workflow runs, verifying schema properties.

methods.name: Test_GetWorkflowRun
methods.description: Tests retrieving details of a specific workflow run.

methods.name: Test_GetWorkflowRunLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieving logs for a workflow run.

methods.name: Test_ListWorkflowJobs
methods.description: Tests listing jobs for a workflow run.

methods.name: Test_RerunFailedJobs
methods.description: Tests rerunning failed jobs within a workflow.
